title: Maim
wikitext:
{{about|the game mechanic|the support gem|Maim Support}}
{{status
| name                   = Maimed
| type                   = Debuff
| icon                   = Maim status icon.png
| description            = You have reduced Movement Speed from being Maimed
| bonuses                = 30% reduced [[movement speed]] on the affected target for 4 seconds.
}}

'''Maim''', or the debuff name '''Maimed''', is a [[keyword]] [[debuff]] that causes the affected target to have {{c|mod|30% reduced Movement Speed}} and has a default [[duration]] of 4 seconds. Maim is applied by [[attack]]s, just like [[hinder]] is by [[spell]]s. It visibly appears as dark red pools on the ground the maimed entity stands on. 

==Mechanics & interactions==
* Since maim and hinder are different debuffs, an enemy can be affected by both simultaneously.<ref name="220Patch" />
* Multiple maims do not stack.<ref name="MarkMaimReddit" />
* Multiple sources of the stat {{c|mod|Enemies Maimed by you take #% increased Damage Over Time}} stack as long the as the maim is applied by the same entity.
